notes: All numbers in card units (multiply by k). Rows replace the old hp/atk/def/spd text line at y130. No bars (stats can exceed 100). Optional faint leader line from x0 to x1 at row y+5. Number is bold numFont, right-aligned, works up to 3 digits. Icon files: ui/stats/stat_<key>_8.png for k<2, _16.png for k>=2. Number right-aligned at numX. Font bold monospace 7*k.
